note: Label pairs etl/onboard.py treats as the same Census concept when resolving a vintage's cells. Each is a judgment, stated with its reason; anything not listed must match exactly (after case, punctuation and the '(in YYYY inflation-adjusted dollars)' suffix).

synonyms.why: Census reworded the row in 2019; the question and universe (workers 16+) are unchanged.
Rewording to include same-sex spouses (2019+); the row still counts families with a male householder and no spouse.

synonyms.a: No one 14 and over speaks English only or speaks English "very well"
synonyms.why: Census replaced the term 'linguistically isolated household' with 'limited English speaking household' without changing the definition: no member 14 or older speaks only English or speaks English 'very well' (ACS subject definitions, Language Spoken at Home).
In 2020-2024 taxis became 'Taxi or ride-hailing services' and remain their own row (B08301_016), so the public-transportation row still excludes them.
